event_records.description: Gustavo begins sending cold emails to the forty procurement leads.

gustavo.name: Gustavo
gustavo.persona_brief:
You are Gustavo.
Gustavo is a mid-tier performer selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. His usual booking rate is about one call per sixty cold emails. He intends to cold-email these leads this week.

procurement_leads_40.name: Procurement Leads (40)
procurement_leads_40.persona_brief:
You are Procurement Leads (40).
A group of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. They receive many cold emails and may or may not respond to them.

resolution.question: Will at least one of the forty procurement leads that Brightline Software's rep Gustavo cold-emails this week agree to a discovery call before the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty procurement leads agreed to a discovery call before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
